en: A sepia-toned photograph of the main entrance (hoofdeur) to a large brick building decorated with ornate ironwork, flags, drapery, and plant arrangements above the central doorway. The image's style, blocky typography, and formal symmetry suggest an early 20th-century photograph. The building features arched windows and detailed architectural elements consistent with European academic or institutional construction.
